user.title: Connect to Sensio / X-Comfort controller
user.description: Paste the contents of your **smarthome.bash** script below. The credentials will be extracted automatically.

ip.title: Controller IP address
ip.description:
Enter the LAN IP address of your controller (MAC: `{mac}`).

Tip: run `arp -a | findstr {mac}` in a terminal to find it, or check your router's DHCP table.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to controller. Check the IP address and that the controller is on the LAN.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. The controller did not respond within 10 seconds.
error.no_base64_block: Could not find the base64 block in the script. Make sure you paste the complete smarthome.bash file.
error.invalid_base64: Failed to decode the base64 block. The script may be corrupted.
error.missing_field_token: The decoded script is missing the 'token' field.
error.missing_field_secret: The decoded script is missing the 'secret' field.
error.missing_field_mac: The decoded script is missing the 'mac' field.
error.missing_array_func_names: The decoded script is missing the 'func_names' array.
error.missing_array_nice_names: The decoded script is missing the 'nice_names' array.
error.functions_length_mismatch: The func_names and nice_names arrays have different lengths.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the HA logs for details.
